description: Unified confidence scoring for live bot. Provides a scalar confidence in [0,1] for supported core engines. Each engine section defines required inputs and scoring.

EMA_RB_v3c.intent: Confidence for rollback_winner_v3c (Winner C engine). Uses z strength, slope strength, and agreement between fast_sign/vwap_sign and dir_lr; penalizes near0 and flip risk.

inputs.final_pred_dir: final prediction direction (+1 Bull, -1 Bear, 0 Neutral)

equations.agree_fast: 1 if fast_sign != 0 and fast_sign == final_pred_dir else 0
equations.agree_vwap: 1 if vwap_sign != 0 and vwap_sign == final_pred_dir else 0
equations.agree_z: 1 if dir_lr != 0 and dir_lr == final_pred_dir else 0
equations.penalty: penalty_near0*(1 if near0 else 0) + penalty_flip*(1 if flip_flag else 0)

notes: Confidence is computed AFTER final_pred is determined. If final_pred_dir==0 then confidence=0.
This scoring is designed to work purely from EMA_RB_v3c inputs (no legacy VWAP/EMA committee).

B1_core_v1_1.intent: Confidence for offline/back-up B1 core. Uses EMA240 slope strength and VWAP drift agreement. Penalizes near0 volume if available.

inputs.pred_dir: B1 prediction direction (+1 Bull, -1 Bear, 0 Neutral)
inputs.ema_strong_threshold: ema_strong threshold used by B1 core (float)
inputs.near0: optional bool; if missing assume False

notes: This block exists so the same confidence.json can be used for offline evaluation of B1_core_v1_1.
